verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs describe only key/timestamp-based incremental replication state tracking (meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30), with no documented binlog/WAL log-based CDC capability. Community evidence explicitly notes that logical replication (WAL-based CDC) 'broke down quite quickly' when attempted with Meltano/Singer taps (meltano-comm-2), while primary-key+updated_at incremental sync works instead — confirming CDC is not a delivered capability, not merely undocumented.
